# FDG8052

> CONSIDER defining the `Clone` method on types that need a cloning mechanism. Ensure that the documentation clearly states whether it is a deep-copy or a shallow-copy.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.5 ICloneable.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a type needs a cloning mechanism, and what its documentation says, is judgment.

```csharp
public class Customer {
  public Customer Clone();
  ...
}
```
